subject: release-tooling/declarative-update-executor
statement: Future Agent DevTools source releases should use the stable declarative update executor plus JSON scenario rather than generating one-off Python publishers. Scenarios are data only: exact baseline guards and bounded file transformations; Git isolation, qualification, recovery/provenance and publication remain centralized in the executor/canonical release builder.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement R7 Declarative Update Executor: stable stdlib JSON scenario engine over the existing safe isolated updater.
